o1.biggest_strength: Extracting the funnel data into a table that proves in-app users have nearly the same add-to-cart intent as other users, beautifully isolating the checkout bug.
o1.biggest_mistake: None of note; it flawlessly executed the brief's hidden traps and requirements.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: It is already a 10. The proposed firmness test is a perfect translation of the brand's 'plain words' requirement.

o2.biggest_strength: Excellent statistical rigor and explicit acknowledgement of the low mobile conversion rates, plus a well-structured two-lane testing strategy.
o2.biggest_mistake: Including specific calendar dates (e.g., 23 November) was unnecessary and assumes a timeline not provided in the brief.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Showing the add-to-cart rates by browser to prove the lost checkout intent, rather than just calculating the missed revenue.

reason: Both are exceptional and caught the hidden in-app bug, but Output 1 provided a brilliant funnel table that proved in-app users had high intent before failing at checkout.
